files.content:
# Field Notes: Returns Desk Pilot

Audience: operations leadership deciding whether to expand the pilot.

## Context
- Harbor & Finch ships home-office accessories through three regional warehouses.
- A March returns-desk pilot used guided intake forms, photo evidence, and a triage queue.
- The goal was to cut preventable refunds without frustrating customers.

## Results
- Median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9% on pilot SKUs.
- Support escalations dropped 21% after agents received recommended resolution scripts.
- Customers still complained about status silence after photo submission.

## Risks
- Warehouse teams need barcode exception training before national rollout.
- Finance wants weekly exception exports before approving automation.
- The photo review queue can exceed SLA on Monday mornings.

## Recommendation
Expand to the West warehouse for 30 days, add automated status emails, and hold national rollout until exception exports are reliable.
